It is recorded as a repair row, with no SQL run, by the 2026-09-14 ledger reconciliation (docs/runbooks/supabase-ledger-reconciliation-2026-09-14.md). But the fab-release gate has diverged: live evaluate_release_gate md5 c4d43eb981ea9bc43d096708e6e1b541 (10622 bytes) is NOT this file (d146c39a174e65f9c4924df665d8332d, 11524 bytes), and no repo migration redefines it, so this file is the tracked head and the live body is undocumented drift. The live gate delegates to work_package_drawing_set_reports(uuid), which is defined in NO migration file, which in turn calls evaluate_fab_release_set(uuid,uuid), which has zero occurrences anywhere under supabase/ - two layers deep. piece_control_drawing_is_approved has also drifted from a tracked SECURITY INVOKER per-sheet predicate to a 327-char SECURITY DEFINER set-level delegate, a privilege-level change. Divergence is bidirectional: applying this file would DELETE live blockers from the P0 path (open_rfis, active_holds, superseded sheets, no_file) and change the output keys two live callers consume (release_work_package_canonical_impl, piece_control_pilot_readiness). DELIBERATELY NOT APPLIED - it would contradict a newer decision, and buys no security. It adds RESTRICTIVE pm role-floor policies to four authority tables. Three already enforce pm through their permissive policies (drawing_revisions and project_closeout are pm on INSERT and UPDATE; no table has a DELETE policy, so deletes are already denied), making those nine policies pure defence in depth. The fourth is a live conflict: change_requests INSERT is field, and create_change_request is SECURITY INVOKER with its own field floor and inserts directly, so RLS applies as the caller. Adding a pm restrictive policy would make that RPC fail for field users with a raw RLS violation instead of its own message. Latent today (0 users hold field; every org defaults to viewer) but it would fire the first time a field user is added. The RPC is the later decision, so field users raising a PCO is read as current intent. Whether only PMs may open a change request is a product question for the owner; if the answer is pm, apply this file AND raise create_change_request to pm together so the error stays truthful. Only email_integration_settings received these policies when this migration last ran.
